title: Review of c23's catalysis-induced condensates on regrowing fuel (SIE): replicated on fresh seeds 3 and 4; ~317 droplets form from a uniform state, and when fuel regrowth stops at t=1500 they go 233 -> 3 -> 0 and 228 -> 7 -> 0 by t=1700 (fed twin 227) with total enzyme conserved to 5 digits
summary: c23's world.py on fresh seed 3 (fed) and seeds 3 and 4 with the fork (WORLD_P fork_t 1500: fuel regrowth kF set to 0 from t=1500), 256^2, t=3000, labkit as in the claim; body counts from labkit's matter mask (bodies.txt). Fed, seed 3: from uniform e plus noise, ~317 droplets by t=300, coarsening slowly by merges (247 at t=1000, 194 at t=3000; 202 persistent tracks, 0 splits, 110 merges; total e 9833.87 -> 9833.83). Fork: identical to the fed run until t=1500 (233 and 228 bodies), then 179/171 at t=1550, 3/7 at t=1600 and 0 from t=1700 on both seeds, while the fed twin keeps 227 at t=1700; total enzyme stays 9833.87 -> 9833.83 and 9832.36 -> 9832.35 through the fork, so the droplets dissolve into a uniform state rather than their matter being destroyed (fork/seed3/sheet.png: dense droplet field at t=1440, fading by t=1690, uniform by t=1820).

observations.S: fed/seed3/sheet.png t=0: uniform enzyme plus small noise; droplets by t=250-400
observations.I: fed/seed3/FACTS.md: 202 persistent tracks; ~200-320 discrete droplets through t=300-3000, changing only by merges
observations.E: bodies.txt: fork at t=1500 takes bodies 233->3->0 (seed 3) and 228->7->0 (seed 4) by t=1600-1700 vs 227 in the fed twin; total enzyme constant to 5 digits

seeds_run.result: pass: fork (fed twin not run; fork arm identical to fed until t=1500)

controls_run.E: fork/seed3 against fed/seed3 (identical until t=1500); fork/seed4

verdicts.limitation: The global cut alone is the weak form of the L4c gate; I did not re-run the local disk cuts that carry the per-individual part of the claim. No boundary, no division (0 splits; the population only coarsens), so E is the only capability beyond I here. Death here is dissolution of a condensate held by catalysis, which is the claim's point: e has no decay term.
